answer: Every identity joins by locking a copper receipt chained to its sponsor's receipt, back to a genesis attester; the k-th member posts a bond of k squared copper units, so N clones cost roughly N cubed while an honest singleton pays one unit. Each epoch a random signal picks a few receipts for audit, and the plume fans out along the whole chain: every member must present a fresh sequential proof salted with its own address. Proofs are memory-hard and sequential, so a botnet cannot parallelize or share them. One broken link slashes the whole chain, making Sybil growth its own tax.
